title: Kit Presente Top Cropped Sem Bojo Feminino Academia | Kit 4 Cores Microfibra Alça Larga Cós Largo
description:
Kit Presente Top Cropped Sem Bojo Feminino Academia: 4 tops em 4 cores por R$ 51,90.

Quer presentear sem errar? Leve as 4 cores de uma vez: preto, branco, azul-marinho e rosa.

Por que esse kit:
- 4 tops cropped femininos por R$ 51,90, menos de R$ 13 por peça
- Microfibra lisa e macia, confortável na pele
- Sem bojo e sem enchimento: modelagem leve e natural
- Alça larga, mais conforto nos ombros
- Cós largo na barra para um caimento firme e confortável
- Corte cropped: combina com cintura alta, calça de linho e legging

Para presentear:
- Aniversário, Dia das Mães, amigas e quem ama treinar
- Ideal para academia, treino em casa, caminhada ou dia a dia

Como cuidar:
- Lavar em ciclo delicado, de preferência à mão
- Secar à sombra para manter a cor e o caimento

O kit tem 4 unidades. Confira a tabela de medidas antes de comprar e garanta o seu!
coverBrief: Square product cover generated by image-to-image edit from the attached reference photo (the 4 tops, not the models). The product is shown alone with NO person, NO model and NO face, in a clean 2x2 grid on a neutral plain light off-white background with soft even studio lighting and soft shadows: top-left black, top-right white, bottom-left navy blue, bottom-right hot pink. The tops keep the reference cut: sleeveless, scoop neckline, wide shoulder straps, wide bottom band, cropped length, smooth microfiber look with no padding. A bold black 'KIT 4' heading sits at the top, as in the reference. Gift-ready, premium catalog mood for the presente angle. Saved to runs/campaigns/kit-4-top-cropped-sem-bojo-nndf0/r1/covers/v02.png.
hypothesis: A solo_grade 2x2 four-colour grid with a gift story (presente angle, afiliado acquisition) will lift CTR over the competitor set, which mostly shows models or titles without a gift frame.

benchmark.pricePosition: R$ 12,98 per piece (R$ 51,90 / 4) against a median of R$ 48,08 across 20 competitors; the kit is 8% above the median and cheaper than 25% of competitors. Per piece it is above the four referenced kit competitors (R$ 9,98 to R$ 12,50 per piece), so the pitch is the gift story and the 4 colours, not the lowest price.
differentiators: Alça larga: 15% of competitor titles use alça fina, so the wide strap is a distinct construction claim
Microfibra without padding (sem bojo): microfiber appears in 20% of competitor titles, and this kit states no enchimento
4 colours in one kit (preto, branco, azul-marinho, rosa) for a gift that works with any taste
Price per piece of R$ 12,98 is just above the kit-of-4 competitors (R$ 9,98 to R$ 12,50), so the value case rests on the 4 colours and gift framing, not on price
